summary: Unified high-performance architecture, infrastructure optimization, and semantic caching strategies. Integrated resource-efficient CI/CD workflows, concurrency management, and sqlite-vec based caching layers to maximize throughput, minimize latency, and ensure robust, scalable system statefulness.
key_learnings: Binary Quantization and sqlite-vec facilitate high-performance vector storage and semantic caching with minimal overhead.
Resource management via semaphore-based concurrency and dynamic CI/CD pruning prevents bottlenecks and waste.
Strict semantic similarity thresholds and TTL policies are required to maintain data freshness and prevent stale state propagation.
